BzGrid.name: BzGrid
BzGrid.summary: A virtualized data grid. Only the rows in view exist in the DOM, so it stays fast with hundreds of thousands of rows. Declare columns with BzColumn inside it.
BzGrid.remarks: Filtering, sorting and grouping run in .NET or in a background Web Worker (see Engine). With none of them active, new data goes straight to rendering. Scrolling re-renders only the body, and column widths live in CSS variables, so resizing never re-renders cells.
BzGrid.example:
<BzGrid TItem="Order" Items="orders" Height="600px" PageSize="100" StateKey="orders">
    <BzColumn Field="Id" Title="#" Locked="ColumnLock.Left" />
    <BzColumn Field="Customer" Filter="FilterKind.MultiSelect" />
    <BzColumn Field="OrderDate" Format="yyyy-MM-dd" />
    <BzColumn Field="Amount" Format="C2" />
</BzGrid>

members.name: ChildContent
members.summary: The BzColumn declarations. Columns render nothing themselves.

members.name: Items
members.summary: The rows to display. Replace the list instance to load new data, or call RefreshAsync after changing the same list in place.
members.remarks: With no filter, sort or group active, new data goes straight to rendering: the query engine is not touched.

members.name: Engine
members.summary: Where filtering, sorting and grouping are computed. Auto uses .NET for small data and a background Web Worker from WorkerThreshold rows up.

members.name: WorkerThreshold
members.summary: Row count at which DataEngineMode.Auto switches to the Web Worker engine.

members.name: RowHeight
members.summary: Fixed height of every row in pixels. Virtualization relies on rows all being this height.

members.name: Height
members.summary: CSS height of the grid, e.g. "600px" or "calc(100vh - 200px)". The body scrolls inside it.

members.name: Class
members.summary: Extra CSS class(es) on the grid's root element. The usual hook for a custom theme.

members.name: Style
members.summary: Inline style on the root element. Handy for overriding a few --bz-* variables.

members.name: Theme
members.summary: Adds the class bz-theme-{Theme}. Built in: "dark" and "compact".

members.name: RowClass
members.summary: Returns extra CSS class(es) for a row, or null.

members.name: Overscan
members.summary: Rows rendered above and below the visible window, to keep fast scrolling smooth.

members.name: EmptyTemplate
members.summary: Content shown when there are no rows to display. Defaults to "No records to display".

members.name: Loading
members.summary: Shows the loading overlay. The grid also shows it on its own when a filter, sort or group query takes over 120 ms.

members.name: LoadingText
members.summary: Text of the default loading indicator.

members.name: LoadingClass
members.summary: Extra CSS class on the loading overlay.

members.name: LoadingTemplate
members.summary: Replaces the default spinner and text inside the loading overlay.

members.name: PageSize
members.summary: Rows per page. 0 turns paging off: all rows scroll in one virtualized list.

members.name: PageSizeOptions
members.summary: Choices offered by the pager's page-size selector.

members.name: PagerButtonCount
members.summary: Numbered page buttons shown in the pager. Pages are shown in fixed blocks (1-10, 11-20, …).

members.name: ShowPageSizeSelector
members.summary: Shows the page-size selector in the pager.

members.name: ShowGroupPanel
members.summary: Shows the panel above the header where columns are dropped to group by them.

members.name: GroupsCollapsedByDefault
members.summary: Starts every group collapsed.

members.name: StateKey
members.summary: Persists the layout to localStorage under this key: column order, width, lock and visibility, sorts, filters, groups, group value orders and page size. Null disables persistence.

members.name: ServerMode
members.summary: The grid stops filtering, sorting and paging locally. Handle OnQueryChanged, fetch the requested page, then set Items and TotalCount. Grouping is still applied to the received page.

members.name: TotalCount
members.summary: Server mode: the total row count across all pages, used by the pager.

members.name: FilterOptionsProvider
members.summary: Server mode: returns the values offered by a multi-select filter, given the column's field.

members.name: SelectedItem
members.summary: The highlighted row. Supports @bind-SelectedItem.

members.name: EditTrigger
members.summary: What opens a row for inline editing. None leaves it to BeginEditAsync or the edit command.

members.name: ShowEditCommands
members.summary: Adds a right-locked column with edit, save and cancel buttons.

members.name: OnQueryChanged
members.summary: Raised when filters, sorts, groups, the page or the page size change. In ServerMode this is where you fetch data; GridQuery.Reason says what changed.

members.name: OnFilterChanged
members.summary: Raised when a column filter is set or cleared, in both local and server mode.

members.name: OnStateChanged
members.summary: Raised whenever the persistable layout changes, with the new GridState.

members.name: OnRenderStats
members.summary: Raised after new data is painted, with timings. Useful for benchmarking.

members.name: SelectedItemChanged
members.summary: Raised when the selected row changes (the other half of @bind-SelectedItem).

members.name: OnRowClick
members.summary: Raised when a data row is clicked.

members.name: OnRowDoubleClick
members.summary: Raised when a data row is double-clicked, before edit mode starts.

members.name: OnRowEditStart
members.summary: Raised before a row enters edit mode. Set RowEditStartEventArgs.Cancel to prevent it.

members.name: OnCellValueChanged
members.summary: Raised while editing whenever an editor's value changes (nothing is written to the item yet).

members.name: OnRowEditCommit
members.summary: Raised before changes are written to the item. Set RowEditCommitEventArgs.Cancel and RowEditCommitEventArgs.Error to keep the row in edit mode, e.g. when validation fails.

members.name: OnRowUpdated
members.summary: Raised after changes were written to the item: a good place to call your API. Columns bound to read-only (computed) properties are not written by the grid; apply those changes here.

members.name: OnRowEditCancel
members.summary: Raised when an edit is cancelled (Esc or the cancel button).

members.name: VisibleColumns
members.summary: The visible columns in display order (locked left, scrolling, locked right).

members.name: Columns
members.summary: All registered columns, including hidden ones, in declaration order.

members.name: IsLoading
members.summary: True while the loading overlay is shown (Loading, or a query running over 120 ms).

members.name: EditError
members.summary: The message shown above the grid when an edit was rejected, or null.

members.name: EngineName
members.summary: The engine currently computing queries: "managed", "worker" or "none".

members.name: FilteredCount
members.summary: Data rows after filtering (all pages).

members.name: PageIndex
members.summary: The zero-based current page.

members.name: CurrentPageSize
members.summary: The current page size (0 when paging is off). May differ from PageSize once the user picks another.

members.name: HasGroups
members.summary: True when at least one grouping is active.

members.name: CurrentPageRowCount
members.summary: Data rows on the current page.

members.name: PageCount
members.summary: Number of pages (1 when paging is off).

members.name: TotalItemCount
members.summary: Total data rows across all pages: TotalCount in server mode, else the filtered count.

members.name: Groups
members.summary: Active groupings, outermost first.

members.name: Sorts
members.summary: Active sorts, highest priority first.

members.name: Filters
members.summary: Active column filters.

members.name: FindColumn
members.summary: Finds a column by key (its BzColumn.Field, else its Title). Most methods that act on a column take the ColumnModel returned here.

members.name: RefreshAsync
members.summary: Re-reads the current Items, e.g. after adding or removing rows in the same list instance.

members.name: SetSortAsync
members.signature: Task SetSortAsync(ColumnModel<TItem> col, SortDirection? direction, bool append = false)
members.summary: Sorts by a column. Users do the same by clicking a header (Shift+click adds a sort).

params.name: direction
params.summary: The direction, or null to remove this column's sort.

params.name: append
params.summary: Keep the other sorts and add (or update) this one, instead of replacing them.

members.name: SetFilterAsync
members.summary: Sets or clears a column's filter.
members.example:
await grid.SetFilterAsync(grid.FindColumn("Status")!, new ColumnFilter
{
    Kind = FilterKind.MultiSelect,
    Values = new() { "New", "Processing" }
});

params.name: filter
params.summary: The filter, or null (or an inactive filter) to clear it. ColumnFilter.Field is filled in for you.

members.name: ClearFiltersAsync
members.summary: Removes every column filter.

members.name: GroupByAsync
members.summary: Groups by a column. Ignored if the column is not groupable or already grouped.

params.name: index
params.summary: Position among the groupings (0 = outermost); -1 adds it innermost.

members.name: UngroupAsync
members.summary: Removes the grouping on a column key.

members.name: ToggleGroupDirectionAsync
members.summary: Flips a grouping between ascending and descending.

members.name: MoveGroupAsync
members.summary: Moves a grouping outward (negative delta) or inward (positive).

members.name: SetAllGroupsCollapsed
members.summary: Expands or collapses every group.

members.name: EffectiveGroupOrder
members.summary: The explicit order of group values for a column: the user's order from the menu, else the column's GroupOrder.

members.name: SetGroupOrderAsync
members.summary: Sets (or with null, clears) the user-defined group value order for a column.

members.name: SetLockAsync
members.summary: Locks a column to the left or right edge, or unlocks it.

members.name: SetVisible
members.summary: Shows or hides a column.

members.name: ShowAllColumns
members.summary: Makes every column visible.

members.name: AutoFitAsync
members.summary: Sizes a column (or, with null, every column) to fit its header and a sample of its data.

members.name: SetPageAsync
members.summary: Goes to a zero-based page (clamped to the valid range).

members.name: SetPageSizeAsync
members.summary: Changes the page size (0 turns paging off) and returns to the first page.

members.name: CurrentQuery
members.summary: A snapshot of the current filters, sorts, groups and page, e.g. to send to an API.

members.name: BeginEditAsync
members.summary: Puts the row showing item into edit mode (any row being edited is committed first).

members.name: CommitEditAsync
members.summary: Saves the row being edited, raising OnRowEditCommit then OnRowUpdated.
members.returns: False if the commit was cancelled or a value could not be converted; the row stays in edit mode.

members.name: CancelEditAsync
members.summary: Discards the row being edited.

members.name: GetState
members.summary: The current persistable layout. Serialize it to save layouts server-side.

members.name: SetStateAsync
members.summary: Applies a layout previously returned by GetState. Entries for unknown columns are ignored.

members.name: ResetStateAsync
members.summary: Clears persisted state and restores the defaults from the column definitions.

BzColumn.name: BzColumn
BzColumn.summary: Declares a column of a BzGrid. Place it inside the grid; it renders nothing itself.
BzColumn.remarks: Parameters are read once, when the column registers with the grid. Changing a parameter afterwards (for example Title) is not picked up yet; use @key on the grid to rebuild it if you need to.
BzColumn.example:
<BzColumn Field="Customer.Name" Title="Customer" Filter="FilterKind.MultiSelect" Width="180" />
<BzColumn Field="Amount" Format="C2" Locked="ColumnLock.Right" />

members.name: Field
members.summary: The property to show. Nested paths such as "Customer.Name" work, and a null anywhere along the path shows as blank. Also the column's key in state, sorts, filters and groups.
members.remarks: Leave it out for a template-only column (e.g. action buttons); such a column can't be sorted, filtered or grouped.

members.name: Title
members.summary: Header text. Defaults to Field.

members.name: Format
members.summary: .NET format string applied to the value, e.g. "C2", "N0" or "yyyy-MM-dd".

members.name: FormatProvider
members.summary: Culture used with Format. Defaults to the current culture.

members.name: DisplayText
members.summary: Custom display text for a row. Also used for text filtering, multi-select values and grouping.

members.name: Width
members.summary: Initial width in pixels. Null measures the header and a sample of the data once the data arrives.

members.name: MinWidth
members.summary: The narrowest the user can resize the column to.

members.name: MaxAutoWidth
members.summary: The widest automatic sizing (initial measure or "Fit width") will make the column.

members.name: Locked
members.summary: Locks the column to the left or right edge so it stays put while scrolling horizontally.

members.name: Visible
members.summary: Initial visibility. Users can hide and show columns from the column menu.

members.name: Align
members.summary: Text alignment. Auto right-aligns numbers and left-aligns everything else.

members.name: Filter
members.summary: The filter UI in the column menu. Auto picks it from the property type (text, number, date, or multi-select for bool and enums).

members.name: Sortable
members.summary: Clicking the header sorts by this column.

members.name: Filterable
members.summary: The column menu offers a filter for this column.

members.name: Groupable
members.summary: The column can be grouped by (dragged to the group panel, or from its menu).

members.name: Resizable
members.summary: The user can drag the header edge to resize the column.

members.name: Reorderable
members.summary: The user can drag the header to move the column.

members.name: Editable
members.summary: Whether the cell gets an editor in edit mode. Null means editable when the property has a public setter. Set true with an EditTemplate to edit a read-only (computed) property.

members.name: GroupOrder
members.summary: A fixed order for group values (by display text), e.g. a status workflow. Values not listed follow in natural order. An order the user sets in the column menu overrides this one.

members.name: CellClass
members.summary: CSS class(es) on every cell of this column.

members.name: CellClassSelector
members.summary: Returns extra CSS class(es) for one cell, or null. Use it for conditional formatting.

members.name: HeaderClass
members.summary: CSS class(es) on the header cell.

members.name: Template
members.summary: Renders the cell with any markup or components. context is the row's item.

members.name: HtmlTemplate
members.summary: A lighter alternative to Template: HTML with {{Field}} or {{Field:format}} placeholders. Values are HTML-encoded.

members.name: EditTemplate
members.summary: Editor used for this cell while its row is in edit mode. Read and set context.Value.

members.name: FooterTemplate
members.summary: Content of this column's cell in a footer row pinned under the data. The footer appears when any visible column has one.

members.name: GroupHeaderTemplate
members.summary: Replaces the default "Title: value (count)" content of group rows when grouping by this column.

ColumnModel.name: ColumnModel
ColumnModel.summary: A column at runtime: its BzColumn definition plus the current layout. Get one from BzGrid.FindColumn, Columns or VisibleColumns and pass it to the grid's column methods.

members.name: Def
members.summary: The column's declaration (its parameters).

members.name: Key
members.summary: The key used in state, sorts, filters and groups: the Field, else the Title.

members.name: Kind
members.summary: The filter kind in effect (Auto resolved from the property type).

members.name: IsNumeric
members.summary: True for numeric, date and bool properties (they sort and filter as numbers).

members.name: IsDate
members.summary: True for DateTime, DateTimeOffset and DateOnly properties.

members.name: IsBool
members.summary: True for bool properties.

members.name: IsEnum
members.summary: True for enum properties.

members.name: Width
members.summary: Current width in pixels.

members.name: Lock
members.summary: Current lock side.

members.name: Order
members.summary: Current display position.

members.name: Visible
members.summary: Whether the column is currently shown.

members.name: Title
members.summary: Header text.

members.name: CanSort
members.summary: The column can be sorted (Sortable and bound to data).

members.name: CanFilter
members.summary: The column can be filtered.

members.name: CanGroup
members.summary: The column can be grouped by.

members.name: CanEdit
members.summary: The column gets an editor in edit mode.

members.name: GetText
members.summary: The cell's display text for an item (DisplayText or the formatted value).

members.name: GetValue
members.summary: The raw property value for an item.

ColumnFilter.name: ColumnFilter
ColumnFilter.summary: A filter on one column. Which properties apply depends on Kind: Text uses TextOperator and Text; Number uses Operator, Number and Number2; Date uses Operator, Date and Date2; MultiSelect uses Values. Filters on different columns are combined with AND.

members.name: Field
members.summary: The column key. Filled in by SetFilterAsync.

members.name: Kind
members.summary: The kind of filter, which decides which other properties are used.

members.name: TextOperator
members.summary: Text filters: the operator.

members.name: Text
members.summary: Text filters: the text to look for.

members.name: Operator
members.summary: Number and date filters: the comparison.

members.name: Number
members.summary: Number filters: the value (the lower bound for Between).

members.name: Number2
members.summary: Number filters: the upper bound for Between.

members.name: Date
members.summary: Date filters: the day (the first day for Between). The time of day is ignored.

members.name: Date2
members.summary: Date filters: the last day for Between.

members.name: Values
members.summary: Multi-select filters: the display values to keep. An empty list matches nothing; null means no filter.

members.name: IsActive
members.summary: True when the filter has enough input to apply (e.g. a Between filter needs both values).

members.name: Clone
members.summary: Returns a deep copy.

SortDescriptor.name: SortDescriptor
SortDescriptor.summary: One sort or grouping: a column key and a direction.

members.name: Field
members.summary: The column key (its Field, else its Title).

members.name: Direction
members.summary: The direction.

members.name: Clone
members.summary: Returns a copy.

GridQuery.name: GridQuery
GridQuery.summary: A snapshot of the grid's query, suitable for sending to an API.

members.name: Filters
members.summary: Active column filters (combine them with AND).

members.name: Sorts
members.summary: Active sorts, highest priority first.

members.name: Groups

members.name: Page
members.summary: Zero-based page.

members.name: PageSize

GridState.summary: Everything the grid persists: column layout, sorts, filters, groups, group value orders and page size. Plain data that serializes to JSON, so you can store named layouts on your server.

members.name: Version
members.summary: Format version.

members.name: Columns
members.summary: Per-column layout.

members.name: Sorts
members.summary: Active sorts, highest priority first.

members.name: Filters
members.summary: Active column filters.

members.name: Groups
members.summary: Active groupings, outermost first.

members.name: GroupOrders

members.name: PageSize
members.summary: The page size the user picked (only restored when the grid has paging on).

ColumnState.name: ColumnState
ColumnState.summary: The persisted layout of one column.

members.name: Field
members.summary: The column key.

members.name: Width
members.summary: Width in pixels, or null when the column is still sized automatically.

members.name: Lock
members.summary: The lock side.

members.name: Order
members.summary: Display position.

members.name: Visible
members.summary: Whether the column is shown.

members.name: NewValue

members.name: Field

members.name: NewValue

members.name: Auto

members.summary: Centered.
